We are a community organisation run by local volunteers, working on clean water, school meals and skills training in twelve villages.

props.question: Can I volunteer?
props.answer: Yes. We train new volunteers every month.

props.question: Can I visit a project?
props.answer: Supporters are welcome on our quarterly site visits.

props.question: Are you registered?
props.answer: Yes, we are a registered non-profit organisation.

props.question: How is my donation used?
props.answer: Ninety percent goes directly to programmes. Our audited accounts are published every year.
